note: Rates re-verified against issuer sources on 12 November 2026 for 56 of 94 cards; the rest still carry May 2026 figures. Six entries were removed in this pass because they are not obtainable Singapore credit cards: DBS Multiplier (a savings account), RHB Shell and DBS Compass (Malaysian and Hong Kong products), and the GrabPay Card, NTUC Plus! Reward rates, caps and fees change often — always confirm current terms with the issuer before applying or spending.
